entry.summary: Bennett Pomana and his wife Pepa share their experience of navigating sepsis diagnosis in Aotearoa New Zealand. Bennett's sepsis journey started when he became ill in December 2022. He spent 10 days in an induced coma in Wellington Regional Hospital's intensive care unit. In this video, the couple talk about Bennett’s ongoing health issues and what can be done to support those diagnosed with sepsis and their families.
